title: revert: remove Flow and its production integrations
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reverts the Flow experiment introduced by #15503, #15563, #15588 and #15597: removes `operations/flow`, its CI workflow, deployment registration, root workspace dependencies and planning documents.
- Restores the pre-Flow shared auth API, Enter news implementation and deployment workflow. Preserves later unrelated dashboard styling and auth-screen fixes.
- Removes Flow-specific shared sign-in options. Leaves the other 27 application registrations unchanged.
- Validated locally: clean root `npm ci`; 28 auth, 88 UI, 10 Observability and 4 deployment tests; SDK/UI/KPI/Observability builds; auth/Enter/Economics typechecks; Biome and diff checks.
- Draft for discussion. No merge or production promotion is authorized yet. Flow source and local working files are preserved outside tracked repository content for R&D.

gist.headline: Flow returns to the workbench
gist.blurb: The Flow experiment is back on the R&D bench. Shared sign-in, Enter news, and deployment wiring return to their pre-Flow paths while the other 27 app registrations stay put.
gist.summary: Reverts the Flow experiment by removing operations/flow, its CI and deployment registration, and Flow-specific sign-in options, while restoring the pre-Flow shared auth API and Enter news implementation.
gist.impact: The other 27 app registrations remain unchanged, and later dashboard styling and auth-screen fixes are preserved; this draft has not been authorized for merge or production promotion.
gist.visual_concept: Flow is an experimental auth-journey application, not a character or mascot. Depict Polli carefully setting a Flow blueprint aside on an R&D workbench, with a cozy CRT showing the restored auth path and a row of 27 small code-plants representing unchanged app registrations.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workshop, Polli gently sets a labeled Flow blueprint on an R&D workbench beside a CRT showing a simple auth path, while rows of tiny code-plants remain undisturbed under a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) glow. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium within the scene, wears a tiny tool belt, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; dark purple (#110518) outlines, chunky sprites, and a warm cream background keep the scene nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
